Chat.Name: Restyle chat
Chat.Hint: Show the chat log, chat cards, dice rolls and the message box as Oblivion-style parchment. This only changes your own view.

Sidebar.Name: Restyle sidebar tabs
Sidebar.Hint: Show Combat, Actors, Items, Journal and the other sidebar tabs as parchment pages, docked or popped out. This only changes your own view.

Controls.Name: Restyle screen controls
Controls.Hint: Show the sidebar tab icons, scene controls, player list, macro bar, scene navigation and token HUD in parchment and bronze. This only changes your own view.

Popups.Name: Restyle tooltips, menus and dialogs
Popups.Hint: Show tooltips, right-click menus, notifications, dialogs, dnd5e's roll dialogs and Configure Settings as parchment. This only changes your own view.
